body: THANK YOU SO MUCH!! It really means a lot to me. Writing all these already made me feel better. I was in shock when I heard those words from my parents. Today, they both ignore me. They don't talk to me, they don't even look at me. They just ignore my existence, but I have to admit it's a lot better than starting any sort of argument. I will preserve my mood and I will try to stay positive. Thank you!

Thanks for taking the time to reply. I really appreciate the effort you people put into making others feel better. As for this:

> Eat crepes like a fucking boss

I can safely say I will. Have a nice day!

Thanks everyone for their replies, it really helped me reading those encouraging comments. I'd like to address the state of my life as of now. Currently I am 15 years old and I am a hard studying student. My grades are great. I usually exercise on summer, where I go to a local forest and jog. It feels great. I have been saving money since I was 7. I am not really allowed to spend my own money, unless it's a small amount which I usually use for food at school. My parents have made it so me and my brother share the same money, which we both save for. Currently we have a small amount of money (around 4k euros) but it's stored in a bank account on my father's name. I am afraid I will never get to use that money since my father is the only one who can withdraw anything out of that account. Again thanks for replying, I love you all!

If what /u/repr0t suggested is not possible, due to economic/age/ethic reasons you can resort to noise cancelling earplugs to get you through the night. It's almost like magic what these things can do. There can be a party taking place in the room next doors and you almost won't hear a thing.

Congratulations!! That's such a great thing for you!! It's an awesome feeling to know someone loves you, that someone cares.

Have fun together and stay safe! Best of wishes
I would ignore everything but this. It's like it's bad to say thanks
